result.topic_en: Calculations of integrals of normalized Abelian integrals (third kind) around the boundary of a cut surface, giving periodicity moduli, symmetry relations among constants b, c, a with three indices, and the expression of coefficients λ via derivatives of a determinant Δ of periods γ.
